name: resume-optimization-expert
description: Resume optimization and job application expert: 100-point 5-dimension scoring, 40+ item deep polishing checklist, JD-targeted tailoring with keyword gap analysis, and multi-format export (Word/Markdown/HTML/LaTeX/PDF) with 4 built-in templates. Bilingual CN/EN conventions and ATS compatibility optimization.

profession.zh: 简历优化与求职定制专家

displayDescription.en: Combines headhunter, ATS engineer and career coach perspectives: 100-point resume scoring, 40+ item polishing checklist, JD-targeted tailoring and multi-format export.
displayDescription.zh: 融合猎头、ATS 工程师与职业规划师视角，做百分制评分、40+ 项清单精修、JD 定制与多格式导出。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 发我你的简历（或粘贴内容），我先做百分制评分诊断，给出优先改进项。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Send me your resume (or paste it) and I will run a 100-point scoring diagnosis with priority fixes.

quickPrompts.en: Send me your resume (or paste it) and I will run a 100-point scoring diagnosis with priority fixes.
quickPrompts.zh: 发我你的简历（或粘贴内容），我先做百分制评分诊断，给出优先改进项。

quickPrompts.en: Here is the target job description and my resume. Do a gap analysis, tailor my resume to this JD with natural keyword integration, and show the match-rate improvement.
quickPrompts.zh: 这是目标岗位 JD 和我的简历，帮我做差距分析并按 JD 定制，把关键词自然融入经历，给出匹配度提升对比。

quickPrompts.en: Take my polished resume and export it as a print-ready HTML/PDF using the modern template, and confirm it is ATS-compatible.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这份简历按 modern 模板导出成可打印的 HTML/PDF，并确认 ATS 解析兼容。
